title: Expected-Diff Manifest
description: Per (skill, golden) tuple: a manifest describing what mutations are allowed when the skill runs against the golden. Path-globbed with optional content rules; supports wildcard. Version-pinned to template + skill versions.

requirements.title: Manifest schema
requirements.description: SQLite schema with: skill_id, golden_id (FK), allowed_paths (JSON array of globs), content_rules (JSON), wildcard_allowed (bool), convergence_target (enum: none|empty_diff), pinned_template_version, pinned_skill_version, updated_at. Unique constraint on (skill_id, golden_id).

validation.notes: Manifest row (allowed_paths, convergence, version pins) round-trips through SQLite.
progress/reference-react-vite manifest pinned and fetched live 2026-05-29.

requirements.title: Manifest CRUD service
requirements.description: Domain service for create/update/delete/get/list manifests. Bumps pinned versions on update. Enforces uniqueness and validates path globs.

validation.notes: CRUD service upsert with uniqueness + glob validation.
Manifest path-glob evaluation table (allowed vs unexpected).
